verdict.rationale: Codegen docs confirm agents present a structured implementation plan before executing (codegen-docs-22), and agent runs can be paused/resumed (codegen-docs-35), suggesting some capacity to review before proceeding. However, there is no explicit documentation of a formal approval gate that blocks code changes until the developer approves the plan — the workflow described emphasizes autonomous execution with post-hoc PR review rather than a pre-execution approval step. Missing for 10: explicit approval/gating mechanism tied to the plan display, documentation of how pause interacts with plan review, and any UI/CLI flow showing 'approve plan' before code is written.
